title: Activate the componentDidMount lifecycle
intent: Wire the dormant Block CDM lifecycle end-to-end: Router emits FLOW_CDM after mounting a page, dispatch recurses into children and hbs-children, and the known consumers (ChatPage, AssistantPage) move onto it — removing the constructor workaround.

requirements.title: CDM lifecycle activation
requirements.description: Router.render dispatches CDM on the mounted page; dispatchComponentDidMount recurses into both this.children and _hbsChildren; remount stays non-duplicating; ChatPage fetchChats returns to componentDidMount; the dormant AssistantPage.loadChats CDM comes alive; regression tests cover all of it.
requirements.source: live-smoke LIVE-3 follow-up; docs/progress/progress_log.md 2026-10-16 (core debt); assistant.ts:105 dormant CDM

constraints: No behavior change beyond the activated lifecycle: render order, EventBus flow (init → render → CDM) and destroy stay as documented in AGENTS.md.

main.ts bootstrap stays untouched (forbidden); the cold-load double fetch is safe because OwnWsAdapter.connect dedupes sockets synchronously and Store.set suppresses identical writes — the smoke pins the exact fetch profile.
Block core edits are limited to dispatch recursion, the per-instance mounted guard and its full short-circuit; no props/CDU changes.
